Your report will go here.

```{r}

library(tidyverse)

# Data 
democracy_data <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2024/2024-11-05/democracy_data.csv')

```
```{r}
# Commonwealth 

commonwealth <- democracy_data |>
  filter(is_commonwealth == TRUE)

commonwealth |>
  group_by(country_name) |>
  count()

```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)


world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")


commonwealth_1950 <- commonwealth |>
  filter(year == 1950)

world <- world |>
  mutate(is_commonwealth = name %in% commonwealth_1950$country_name)

ggplot(data = world) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = is_commonwealth), color = "blue") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "red", "FALSE" = "grey90")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Commonwealth Countries in 1950", fill = "Commonwealth")

  


```

```{r}
commonwealth_2020 <- commonwealth |>
  filter(year == 2020)

world <- world |>
  mutate(is_commonwealth = name %in% commonwealth_2020$country_name)

ggplot(data = world) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = is_commonwealth), color = "blue") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "red", "FALSE" = "grey90")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Commonwealth Countries in 2020", fill = "Commonwealth")

```

Part II

::: Democracy trends :::

```{r}
commonwealth_1950 <- commonwealth_1950 %>%
  mutate(region = sample(c( "Africa", "Asia", "Europe", "America", "Oceania"), n(), replace = TRUE))

commonwealth_2020 <- commonwealth_2020 %>%
  mutate(region = sample(c( "Africa", "Asia", "Europe", "America", "Oceania"), n(), replace = TRUE))

#getting countries

commonwealth_countries_1950 <- commonwealth_1950 %>%
  filter(is_commonwealth = TRUE) %>%
  pull(country_name)

commonwealth_countries_2020 <- commonwealth_2020 %>%
  filter(is_commonwealth = TRUE) %>%
  pull(country_name)

```

```{r}
ggplot(commonwealth_1950, aes(x = electoral_category, fill = region)) +
  geom_bar() +
  theme_minimal() + 
  labs(title = "Electoral Category of Commonwealth Countries in 1950", fill = "Region")
```

```{r}
ggplot(commonwealth_2020, aes(x = electoral_category, fill = region)) +
  geom_bar() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Electoral Category of Commonwealth Countries in 2020", fill = "Region")
```

::: Changes in regime ::: 

```{r}
ggplot(commonwealth_1950, aes(x = regime_category, fill = region)) +
  geom_bar() 

```

```{r}
ggplot(commonwealth_2020, aes(x = regime_category, fill = region)) +
  geom_bar() +
  theme_minimal() 
```
